title: Face Sculpt #035 (중국 · 30대 · 도도한 · 사이렌 눈 +1 · 자연 코 · 하트형 턱 · 정면 · 메이크업 없음 · P50 · 혼합 금속 추 10개/귀 3구멍 · 테마 해양(진주·조개·산호) · 피부톤 올리브 · 렌즈 코발트 블루(둥근 동공))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — warm olive skin with a natural healthy glow, mid 30s, a polished low bun with a few loose strands, vivid deep cobalt-blue coloured contact lenses with round natural pupils, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, looking down along the nose with the chin lifted slightly, lips closed in a faint haughty line, an aloof, haughty expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): extreme siren eyes: very long, very narrow, strongly upturned eyes with the outer corners lifted high and stretched far out toward the temples in a long, razor-sharp upswept cat flick, a pronounced catlike inner point, thick smoky black kohl liner on the waterline and an extremely long, straight, razor-sharp wing reaching toward her temples, heavy dark lashes, in deep amber contact lenses with a big visible iris, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a heart-shaped face: a wide forehead and high, full cheekbones narrowing in a smooth curve into a delicate, pointed, softly rounded chin like the tip of a heart. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about forty in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two small hoop or studs along the edge of the upper lip; four small hoop or studs across the lower lip's edge; two small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, three separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below another with a clear gap of bare skin between each, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit seven pieces above the lobe: four classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, two studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and one in the conch and tragus; five small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; four small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are inspired by the sea: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are round pearl studs, tiny scallop-shell and starfish charms and rings strung with small coral beads. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these three iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly ten separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear dull blue-grey lead a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a shortest chain, tarnished dark silver a square-sided cowbell on a shortest chain, oxidized dark copper a hammer head on a short chain, dull pewter-grey tin a teardrop-shaped sinker on a short chain, dull dark brass a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a cube-shaped block on a long chain, blackened cast iron a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, dark patinated bronze a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longer chain, dull dark brass a round bell on a longer chain, dark patinated bronze a miniature anvil on a longest chain; on the right ear dark patinated bronze a miniature anvil on a shortest chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a shortest chain, dull pewter-grey tin a barrel-shaped weight on a short chain, dull blue-grey lead a pyramid-shaped lump on a short chain, dull dark brass a round bell on a medium chain, tarnished dark silver a hammer head on a long chain, oxidized dark copper a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a long chain, blackened cast iron a teardrop-shaped sinker on a longer chain, dark patinated bronze a cube-shaped block on a longer chain, dull dark brass a square-sided cowbell on a longest chain. On each ear the three iron rings share the weights between them in uneven numbers, each ring carrying its own column of weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between three openings, the weight pulls each earlobe down only very slightly into a soft, healthy loop of skin, a barely noticeable natural droop that is just enough to show the weights are heavy; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pale gold and silver set with white pearls, mother-of-pearl and pink coral, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
